'''2010 Match Play Championship Day 1 Paul Bansal DS Knowledge And Defense (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Paul Bansal]] at [[2010 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Knowledge And Defense (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-knowledgeanddefense-pre.gif|label=Knowledge And Defense (V)}}
* '''Deck name:''' Actually, Luke is my favourite Perry
* '''Username:''' DarkBro
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.3]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
